scope: Independent read-only review of source preparation and post-conversion event gain; excludes device/ring transport and whole-host equivalence.
result: No actionable discrepancy found in the reviewed composition.
checked: nativeMode0ProjectRate requests prepare(applyEventGain:false), so packed24 source conversion uses exact unity gain; original sourceRate path retains default gain application.

CPRRateConvertedStream runs mode0 on ungained interleaved source, then rb_cpr_event_gain_f32 applies one separate Float32 multiplication per emitted sample. Unity preserves sample storage without rewriting.

The gain helper validates the full block and its products before in-place writes; invalid/nonfinite/nonzero-subnormal output rejects without partial sample changes. Round-to-nearest and no-flushing environment is checked.
Converted count is the actual recurrence count; caller does not append a nominal-duration endpoint. Persistent phase/history survives 8192-source-frame blocks and zero-output blocks.

Seek resets and prerolls from immutable source; it retains the partial converted block suffix rather than restarting the native phase at the requested source position. This is application policy, not a recovered Cubase live-seek claim.
limits: Read-only review, no independent rerun of Swift/device tests.
Source admission, attached-media custody, event barrier and source-zero coordinate are dependencies of the earlier sealed profiles.

Block gain failure can occur after the cursor converter state advances. The current method throws and the playback error path must stop/discard that cursor; this review does not authorize retrying it.
No claim that the whole offline action, native default backend or Cubase live device path was reproduced.
